features: Menu architecture: menu bar order is File, Edit, View, Objects, Text, Arrange, Tools, Window, Help. User-defined menu items can be added from the project configuration (to a named top menu, which can also be renamed or replaced).

Main toolbar: New, Open, Save | Run (Citect) | Plant SCADA Studio, Cicode Editor, Setup Wizard | Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo | Send to Front, Send to Back, Bring Forwards, Send Backwards | Group, Ungroup | Help Topics.

Drawing toolbox ('Show Tools' F3, floating): tool per Objects-menu entry (Free Hand Line, Straight Line, Rectangle, Ellipse, Polygon, Pipe, Text, Number, Button, Symbol Set, Trend, Cicode Object, ...) with status-bar descriptions; legacy V3/V4 tools (Animation Point, Color Flood, Bar Graph, String, Animated Symbol, Slider, Keyboard, Size/Move, Variable Tags, even a 'Sparkle' easter-egg tool) appear when Options>'Show version 3.xx/4.xx tools' is enabled.

Floating Zoom window (View>Show Zoom, F10) with Zoom In (Num+) / Zoom Out (Num-); embedded Bitmap Editor (Tools>Bitmap Editor, F9) with its own Save/Zoom In(+)/Zoom Out(-)/Dimensions/Color Select(Shft+P) commands and 'Bitmap size' grow/shrink dialog.

Expression 'wizard' button on every expression/tag field opens a popup menu: Insert Tag..., Insert Function..., Insert Trend Tag..., Build Expression... backed by the Insert Tag/Insert Function/Insert Trend dialogs.

Grid: Grid Setup (pitch x/y, origin x/y, display, snap) + Snap to Grid (F8); Guidelines: per-direction guideline list with Set/Clear/Clear All + Snap to Guidelines (F7); Cross Hair Cursor toggle; Cursor Keys Slow Speed (slow nudge) toggle; Show Tool Bar / Tools / Zoom / Status Bar / Scroll Bars view toggles; Refresh (redraw).
Goto Object (Ctrl+G): tree-based AN/object browser with Up/Down navigation: jumps selection to any animation number.
Object text Find/Replace across 'Current view' or 'All views' with direction and whole-field match; separate File>Find page browser by page name across projects.

Clipboard: Cut/Copy/Paste/Duplicate/Select All plus Paste Special with formats: AVEVA Plant SCADA Graphics Object(s), Device Independent Bitmap, Bitmap, Unformatted Text, Picture (Metafile), Picture (Enhanced Metafile); transparent-paste key color configurable in Options.

Library workflow: Paste Symbol (F6) / Paste Symbol As Flashing / Paste Genie (F11, genie or super genie) / Paste Composite Genie; Copy to Library; Cut Link (break library link = 'AxeSelected'); 'Linked' checkbox on the library browser controls linked vs embedded paste; New Library creation; library item Edit/New from the browser; Pack Libraries (active project / + included projects); Update Pages in Active and Included Projects (re-syncs pages with changed library objects; warns if library-object tracking info missing).

Genies: Genie Parameters... (substitution editing), Edit Composite Genie..., Paste Composite Genie, Attach Super Genies (bindings list), super-genie association syntax '?<datatype> <name>?', genie save validation (no ActiveX in DspSym genies), 'Cannot reparent Composite Genie instance at AN %d', composite-genie cache initialisation ('Initializing composite genie cache').
Object locking: Lock object / Unlock Object / Break Lock Mode (locked objects not selectable until unlocked).

Arrange: Align (V: top/centre/bottom/even, H: left/centre/right/even), Rotate (90-degree CW/ACW), Mirror (V/H), Group/Ungroup, 4-way z-order (Front/Back/Forwards/Backwards), Adjust Position and Size (numeric X/Y + size by % or absolute W/H, with Apply).

Color tooling: 16-color favorites palette with named colors, flashing colors (separate ON/OFF state colors), transparent sentinel color, HLS + RGB editing, color wheel; Swap Color (exact or any/range); Adjust Colors (hue-range remap + lightness/saturation, 'Selected Hues Only'); Convert to Bitmap.

Object identity: every object has an AN (animation number); Access>General exposes AN/Name/Description/Tooltip; object names validated ('Name needs to begin with a letter...', uniqueness 'Object Type %s (AN %d) already uses name %s'); reserved ANs warning ('Do NOT remove reserved animation points!').

Per-object animation model exposed via property-sheet tabs (Appearance/Movement/Scaling/Fill/Input/Slider/Access/Metadata) with per-tab 'Clear Property' and mutual-exclusion rules (Movement vs Slider per axis, Rotational Slider vs H/V Slider); options 'Display properties on new/copy' auto-open the sheet after create/copy.

Symbol Set states: Off Symbol + Symbol 1..8; line styles enumeration Solid/Dash/Dot/Dash Dot/Dash Dot Dot (733-737); gradient directions incl. to/from-middle variants (1668-1675); touch actions Up/Down/Repeat/Double click; 9-point 'Express' center-axis QuickSet picker (Top/Middle/Bottom x Left/Centre/Right).

Page-level: Page Properties (General/Appearance/Keyboard Commands/Events/Environment/Associations), Page Defaults (default template style/resolution/title bar/background), page Events (On page shown etc.), page scan time, cluster context inheritance, 'Ignore Quality' setting, view area W/H, page color.

File-level: New offers Page/Template/Symbol/Genie/Super Genie object classes; Open/SaveAs browses by class tab with thumbnail preview and per-class resolution/title-bar filter; Import (image) and Import As Flashing (primary+flash image pair); Save All; Compile (Alt+F10) and Run (F5) from the editor; Print with page-selection list; MRU of 4 pages persisted as [ctedit] page0..page3 INI keys; warning prompts when pages were changed externally (Studio): 'External Change Detected'.

ActiveX/extensibility: Insert ActiveX Control (registry-enumerated, license-checked, interface-validated IOleObject/IViewObject2/IPersistStorage), Tag Association of bindable control properties to tags with update-on-event, type-compatibility warnings, persist-data-between-pages option, automatic page-saving policy option; Insert Process Analyst; Insert Database Exchange control; Web Content object with URL diagnostics; Pelco Camera Viewer; Scheduler control.

Editor options (Tools>Options): properties on new/copy, save template warning, Modify Object AN field, disable genie forms, display group button, compile enquiry message, fast runtime display (writes .ctF fast-display files), list system pages, show 3.xx/4.xx tools, XP-style buttons default, transparent paste color, ActiveX page-save policy.

Misc behaviors: MDI child windows per page with Window-menu open-page list; status bar; double-click opens object properties; right-click context menu (Cut/Copy/Paste/Group/Ungroup/Properties/Genie Parameters/Edit Composite Genie/Page Properties); broken library link dialog with Yes/No to All; hidden Debug Info 'Hot Spot' tool for symbol hotspot X/Y; multi-language font Script selection with runtime-substitution warning; super-genie generated page edit warning and static (library) page edit redirection.

Keyboard shortcuts (from the menu captions): Ctrl+N/O/S/P, Ctrl+F4, Alt+F10, F5, Alt+F4, Ctrl+Z/Y/X/C/V/D/A/F/H/G, Del, F6 (paste symbol), F11 (paste genie), Ctrl+F11 (paste super genie, legacy string), F7/F8 (snap toggles), F3 (tools), F10 (zoom), F9 (bitmap editor), F12 (Studio), F1 (help), Ctrl+B/I/U (text styles), Ctrl+Shift+A/R/M/G/U/P/K (arrange), Ctrl+E (compile errors, legacy), Num+/Num- (zoom).
